messages:
anya: Quick sync — we need a lighter onboarding path for small customers (low RPS, high variance). Proposal: shortbench + smoke metrics instead of full 1000-sample bench. thoughts?

kyle: +1. What are the must-have gates for this shortbench? latency p95, embedding cosine drift, and a tiny quality sample?

sara: Agree on p95 and quality. For embeddings we should include an inter-run consistency check (cosine delta < 0.03).

jordan: Also consider cost delta vs baseline model. If new model increases cost >15% we want an explicit opt-in for the tenant.

anya: Good call. So proposed shortbench gates: 1) latency p95 <= baseline + 20ms, 2) quality score (task-specific) within -3% of baseline, 3) embeddings cosine delta < 0.03, 4) cost delta <= 15%.

liz: How does this map to pin TTLs? Customers will ask to pin older versions if they see regressions. Default pin TTL of 90 days? Shortbench onboards get shorter TTL (30 days) with a mandatory canary after 30 days.

kyle: 30-day soft pin for light onboards seems reasonable. We should add auto-rollback if canary fails (fail definitions same as gates).

anya: Love the auto-rollback idea — ops-bot, can we add a runbook stub to trigger rollback + customer notif if canary failure?

ops-bot: runbook created: /runbooks/catalog-shortboard-canary-rollback. Trigger: canary failure. Actions: revert to previous pinned model, create incident, email tenant-contact.

jordan: For migrations/deprecations: we should surface a migration window early — at least 60 days before force-swap for customers with >1M tokens/month. For small customers shortboard path + 30-day pin is fine.

sara: Agree. Also recommend we include a minimal eval harness template in onboarding (example prompts + scorer) so customers can self-validate quickly.

anya: Action items: 1) PM (anya) write shortbench spec and gate thresholds by EOD Fri, 2) Eng ML (sara/kyle) prototype shortbench harness + auto-canary rollback hooks (ETA next Wed), 3) Ops (jordan/liz) finalize pin TTL defaults and comm cadence, 4) DevEx: publish quick eval template.

liz: I'll draft the customer comm snippet for migration windows (60d/30d/7d) and pin TTL FAQ.

kyle: One more: add metrics we log to the console dashboard for shortboards (cost delta, p95, quality delta, embedding drift) so customers see the acceptance state in UI.

anya: Perfect. If nobody objects, I'll schedule a 30min sync tomorrow to walk the spec and canaries. :calendar:

jordan: no objections from infra side. +1

sara: +1

liz: +1

kyle: +1

anya: Cool — thanks everyone. I'll post the spec link when ready.
